checkpoints: Every method and seed at step 1600; every primary-seed method at step 16384. Fixed budgets, no test-based selection.
precision: Same as training: BF16 backbone/softmax SDPA, FP32 linear features and attention; no weight quantization

packed_test.aggregation: Token-weighted NLL over complete nonoverlapping target blocks; at most 1023 tail tokens excluded

long_documents.aggregation: Per-document prefix NLL on the same 64 documents, plus disjoint 0:1024, 1024:4096 and 4096:8192 target-position bands

new_domain.handling: Reset between documents and between 1024-target blocks, retain the final partial block. Tokenize original page text without cleaning. Exclude exact normalized-text matches to retained training documents.
new_domain.limitation: A corpus/style transfer check; historical Wikipedia text can overlap web training through quotations or near duplicates. Exact document filtering does not establish full decontamination.

associative_recall.format: Item NNN: single-token value, followed by neutral filler and a repeated queried Item NNN:
metrics: accuracy restricted to distinct values appearing in the table
associative_recall.chance: 1 / number of pairs for candidate-restricted accuracy
associative_recall.limitation: Zero-shot table lookup measures both format comprehension and retrieval after ordinary LM pretraining. Chance-level performance is not evidence that an architecture cannot learn associative recall.

statistics: Paired document bootstrap conditional on trained checkpoints; report each seed, and distinguish 3-seed early-training results from single-seed full-budget results.
cache: Verify full-forward, continued-prefill and token-decode logits; measure actual retained tensor storage, including numerical scale; exclude allocator reserves and weights from cache bytes.
timing: Quality evaluation may share NPU resources with training, but such timings are not efficiency results. Final latency/throughput benchmarks require exclusive cards.
